observationCovarianceSource: registered fixed matrix; never reconstructed from generated shares
inputsEncoding: big-endian binary64 of the fixed covariance, then each row's identity, membership, fieldwork dates and ilr coordinates in schedule order
drawEncoding: big-endian IEEE-754 binary64; draw-major, then component order
coverageFractionRule: one fraction per component and interval level over this dataset's scoring polls; the polls are correlated and are never averaged as independent repetitions

priors.institutePrior: independent and uncentered; centering is an output transform

generation.referenceUse: covariance only; not the initial-state mean and never regenerated
